subject: math.RT
name: Maschke theorem
statement: A representation of a finite group G over a field k is completely reducible whenever the characteristic of k does not divide |G|. Thus every invariant subspace has an invariant complement.

subject: math.RT
name: Schur lemma
statement: A nonzero intertwining map between irreducible representations is an isomorphism. The endomorphisms commuting with an irreducible representation form a division ring; for a finite-dimensional representation over an algebraically closed field, they are exactly the scalar operators.

subject: math.RT
name: Schur character orthogonality
statement: For irreducible complex characters chi and psi of a finite group G, (1/|G|) times the sum of chi(g) times the complex conjugate of psi(g), over g in G, is one if chi=psi and zero otherwise.

subject: math.RT
name: Column orthogonality of characters
statement: For elements g,h of a finite group G, the sum over irreducible complex characters chi of chi(g) times the complex conjugate of chi(h) is zero if g and h are not conjugate. If they are conjugate, the sum equals the order of the centralizer of g.

subject: math.RT
name: Regular representation decomposition
statement: The complex regular representation of a finite group G is the direct sum, over its irreducible representations V, of dim(V) copies of V. Consequently, the sum of dim(V)^2 over the irreducibles equals |G|.

subject: math.RT
name: Frobenius reciprocity
statement: For a subgroup H of a finite group G, an H-representation V, and a G-representation W over a field k, Hom_G(Ind_H^G V,W) is naturally isomorphic to Hom_H(V,Res_H^G W).

subject: math.RT
name: Mackey decomposition theorem
statement: For subgroups H,K of a finite group G and an H-representation V, Res_K^G Ind_H^G V is the direct sum over representatives g of K backslash G / H of Ind_(K intersect gHg^(-1))^K of the restriction of the conjugate representation gV. In gV, an element ghg^(-1) acts as h acts on V.

subject: math.RT
name: Burnside p^a q^b theorem
statement: Every finite group of order p^a q^b, for primes p,q and nonnegative integers a,b, is solvable. Character theory gives a proof by restricting the possible conjugacy classes of a nonabelian simple group.

subject: math.RT
name: Peter-Weyl theorem
statement: For a compact Hausdorff group G, the matrix coefficients of its finite-dimensional continuous unitary irreducible representations span a dense subspace of C(G) in the uniform norm. They also give an orthogonal Hilbert-space decomposition of L^2(G) with respect to Haar measure.

subject: math.RT
name: Complete reducibility for compact groups
statement: Every finite-dimensional continuous complex representation of a compact group admits an invariant positive-definite Hermitian inner product. It is therefore a direct sum of irreducible representations.

subject: math.RT
name: Weyl complete reducibility theorem
statement: Every finite-dimensional representation of a complex semisimple Lie algebra is a direct sum of irreducible representations.

subject: math.RT
name: Highest-weight classification theorem
statement: After choosing a Cartan subalgebra and positive roots in a complex semisimple Lie algebra, its finite-dimensional irreducible representations are classified by dominant integral highest weights. Every such weight occurs and determines a unique irreducible representation up to isomorphism.

subject: math.RT
name: Weyl character formula
statement: For the irreducible finite-dimensional representation V_lambda of a complex semisimple Lie algebra with dominant integral highest weight lambda, its formal character is the quotient of the alternating Weyl-group sum of e^(w(lambda+rho)) by the alternating sum of e^(w(rho)). Here rho is half the sum of the positive roots, and each summand has coefficient det(w).

subject: math.RT
name: Weyl dimension formula
statement: For an irreducible representation of a complex semisimple Lie algebra of dominant integral highest weight lambda, its dimension is the product over positive roots alpha of the ratio of the pairings of lambda+rho and rho with the coroot alpha_vee. Here rho is half the sum of the positive roots.

subject: math.RT
name: Borel-Weil theorem
statement: Let G be a connected simply connected complex semisimple algebraic group, B a Borel subgroup, and lambda a dominant integral weight for the positive roots determined by B. For the associated line bundle G times_B C_(-lambda) on G/B, the space of global sections is the dual of the irreducible representation of highest weight lambda.

subject: math.RT
name: Borel-Weil-Bott theorem
statement: Let G be a connected simply connected complex semisimple group, B a Borel subgroup, lambda an integral weight, and rho half the sum of the positive roots determined by B; set L=G times_B C_(-lambda). If lambda+rho lies on a root reflection hyperplane, all cohomology of L vanishes; otherwise only H^length(w)(G/B,L) is nonzero, and it is the dual irreducible representation of highest weight w(lambda+rho)-rho, where w is the unique Weyl element making lambda+rho dominant.

subject: math.RT
name: Lie triangularization theorem
statement: Every representation of a finite-dimensional solvable complex Lie algebra on a nonzero finite-dimensional complex vector space has a common eigenvector. There is a basis in which every representing operator is upper triangular.

subject: math.RT
name: Engel theorem
statement: If a finite-dimensional Lie subalgebra of gl(V), with V a nonzero finite-dimensional complex vector space, consists entirely of nilpotent operators, then some nonzero vector is killed by every operator in the subalgebra. In particular, a finite-dimensional Lie algebra whose adjoint operators are all nilpotent is nilpotent.

subject: math.RT
name: Harish-Chandra isomorphism
statement: For a complex semisimple Lie algebra g with Cartan subalgebra h and Weyl group W, the rho-shifted Harish-Chandra homomorphism identifies the center of the universal enveloping algebra U(g) with the invariant polynomial algebra S(h)^W.

subject: math.RT
name: Schur-Weyl duality
statement: For a finite-dimensional complex vector space V, the diagonal action of GL(V) and the permutation action of the symmetric group S_d on V tensor-power d commute. The algebras generated by these two actions are mutual commutants in the endomorphism algebra of the tensor power.
